title: bondstone known.json
description: Violations that existed when the repository adopted a rule. `bondstone baseline --known` writes the file; entries are only ever removed.

created.description: The day the file was first written.

items.description: One violation: the rule, the node (or the file, for a violation without a node) and a key that names the problem.
items.x-error: expected `rule`, one of `node` and `path`, and an optional `key`
